messages.subject: Any way to show source code for function under cursor?
messages.subject_clean: Any way to show source code for function under cursor?
messages.body_plain:
Good morning,

Do you know if there is anyway to show the source code for a function under the cursor?

For example, it would be useful to be able to use a keyboard shortcut to open up a new buffer with the source code (e.g. `getAnywhere('function_name')`) for some function under the cursor named "function_name".

I couldn't find anything like this in the docs - is this currently possible with Nvim-R?

Thanks!
Keith

messages.subject: Re: Any way to show source code for function under cursor?
messages.subject_clean: Any way to show source code for function under cursor?
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for the suggestion!

Initially I didn't quite understand what Rinsert was doing, but now I see how it can be useful for this!

In case anyone else is interested, here is a simple function I put together to this effect:

> function ShowRSource()
>     let g:function_name = expand("<cword>")
>     echom "Showing source code for function: \"" . g:function_name . "\""
>   enew
>   set syntax=r
>     execute ":Rinsert " . g:function_name
> endfunction
>
> nmap <localleader>sc :call ShowRSource()<CR>

Cheers,
Keith
